title: Crying Along with Others
desc: You started crying whenever you heard another baby cry, as if their sadness was your sadness too. For someone so tiny, you had the biggest, most tender heart already.
story: When a sound from another room, or a video on someone's phone, set off the most sympathetic little cry we had ever seen. Your bottom lip would quiver first, then your eyes would well up, as if you had taken on the other baby's feelings as your own. We were equal parts amused and completely moved, because nobody asked you to care that much, and yet there you were, fully committed to feeling it alongside them. You were barely weeks old and already the most empathetic person in the room.
